community_list_entries.name: How Does Personalized Memory Shape LLM Behavior? Benchmarking Rational Preference Utilization in Personalized Assistants

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Introduces RPEval, a personalized intent-reasoning dataset with a multi-granularity evaluation protocol. It measures whether LLMs use stored personalized memories rationally or irrationally (e.g., irrelevant preference injection). RP-Reasoner is the accompanying method.
